replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello eStroopaho,

Although two infractions were appealed, you still have a total of 13 infractions. The new punishment guidelines states that 10+ infractions within 8 months results in a 30 day tempban (1 month). I'll leave this appeal open for a senior to review.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez
